NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 25, 7:31 AM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 20.5 DraftKings points for $7,700, at Minnesota. Christian McCaffrey (17.7, $8,600) and Bhayshul Tuten (16.5, $7,300) are next.

Cam Skattebo returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 2.69 projected points per $1,000 at $6,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 25, 7:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 12

Bijan Robinson, ATL at MIN ($7,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.5 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.8 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 20.3 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.66 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 20 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Robinson averaged 20.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 38.9, and he holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 7-point underdog on the road against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 17.25 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF vs SEA ($8,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $8,600. The model gives him 12.9 carries and 4.7 targets. The salary works out to 2.05 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 20 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 33.3, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3-point favorite at home against Seattle, with an implied team total of 24.25 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Bhayshul Tuten, JAX vs TEN ($7,300)

Bhayshul Tuten projects 3rd at the position with 16.5 DraftKings points at $7,300. The model gives him 16.7 carries and 2.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.26 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 20 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Tuten averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.1 and a ceiling of 31.8, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Ollie Gordon II, MIA vs NYJ ($5,800)

Ollie Gordon II projects for 15.0 DraftKings points at $5,800, which works out to 2.59 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 15.4 carries and 1.9 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Gordon averaged 15.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 30.8, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 3.5-point underdog at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 18.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
